bullets.text: a heron stood in the flooded paddy below the temple, not fishing, just standing. outlasted me. i blinked first.
duck reached senyu-ji in light rain. came to a fork and stepped off the trail into the wet grass instead. 🌿
re-strung an old guitar that plays fine. it plays fine. the ritual was the point, not the strings.
low and even, slightly damp. a day that asks for a jacket and nothing else.
do the odd thing and the day answers back in a different accent. mostly the accent is rain.
